latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud ICP Filing Success Data Query Skill.

- Enables automated querying of ICP (beian) filing success information via Alibaba Cloud API, including entity, website, app details, and risk alerts.
- Provides clear setup instructions for required Alibaba Cloud CLI, Python SDK dependencies, and authentication steps.
- Requires explicit confirmation of all user-customizable parameters before querying.
- Includes workflow for RAM permission handling and AI-Mode enabling.
- Outputs formatted ICP filing summary data, including risks, for successful queries.
